payload.title: Leave aggregations out of knowledge searches by default
payload.description: Ryan, 2026-11-04: tag aggregations so they are generally ignored in knowledge searches and the like; their text is mostly a list of titles and crowds out the real articles. Name every search, context pack and retrieval path this applies to, and say how a caller asks to include them. The aggregation stays visible in the References list and on the card, with its children. Screenshot review for any UI. Test: searching a term from the series on Machines on Machines returns the articles, not the hub.
